doc: One branch of the skeleton, as a polyline with radii.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: Parent branch, or -1 for the stem.

fields.name: at
fields.doc: Index of the parent's point it grows from.

fields.name: level
fields.doc: Branch order: 0 stem, 1 limb, 2 twig, 3 sprig.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: Points along the branch, base first (metres).

fields.name: radii
fields.doc: Radius at each point (metres), by the pipe model.

fields.name: bones
fields.doc: The bone that owns each point.
